zh: 设置页新增「桌面端」页放「标题进入顶栏」，进这一页时开头说明它只作用于 Windows 桌面端的窗口；「首页版面」挪到「外观」，「封号彩蛋」挪到「侧栏」并挂在打开它的账号弹层那一行下面，「搜索框样式」与「对话统计信息位置」的说明写出每个选项的效果。
en: The settings page gains a Desktop tab carrying Header in the title bar with a line saying its settings act on the Windows desktop window only; Home layout moves to Appearance, the Account-hold easter egg to Sidebar under the row of the account popover it opens from, and Search box style and Conversation statistics position now say what each choice does.
